configuration: The official Muñoz21 tutorial initial-condition configuration at seed 911, HII_DIM=64, DIM=172, BOX_LEN=200 Mpc and four threads. Only the module-local density and relative-velocity outputs run; downstream thermal, ionisation and brightness-temperature stages are excluded.
observable: Density and scalar-v_cb summaries plus dimensional low/mid/high-k power with explicit bins and mode counts, the official v_cb RMS/Maxwell anchors, and the production P_vcb(k) input on fixed physical k.
default_vs_upstream: same tutorial template, seed and grid; N_THREADS=4 is explicit and only the approved initial-condition stage runs
knobs: SAB_DIM, SAB_HII_DIM and SAB_THREADS expose the two grid sides and OpenMP worker count; defaults are the graded values.
variant: BOX_LEN and all Fourier bins remain fixed. SIGMA_8 moves upward by exactly two float32 ulps, smoothly perturbing amplitude while retaining the tutorial configuration.
altbuild: none: an alternative compiler build is deferred because this single arm64 host cannot establish a portable cross-build floor.

evidence.spread_how: The official two-ulp SIGMA_8 run moved spectra by about 3e-7. A one-thread run changes the legal random realization: v_cb low/mid/high band power changed by 29.1%, 1.78% and 0.19%; its RMS changed by 8.30%. Density band power changed by at most 2.29%. Disabling relative velocities caused a hard missing-v_cb failure. Replacing the template by ordinary CLASS plus relative velocities passed with 1.8e-9 distance, confirming that this leaf protects tutorial configuration rather than unique Muñoz21 downstream physics.

warrant: This is deliberately named a Muñoz21 initial-condition configuration regression, not a reproduction of the full Muñoz21 scientific result. Within this module the template-specific active matter choice is USE_RELATIVE_VELOCITIES, which also forces CLASS; SOURCE_MODEL and the many astrophysical options do not create distinct initial density/v_cb physics. The check therefore protects the official example's configuration and scale but does not claim an independent algorithm beyond the relative-velocity check. Turning relative velocities off must fail; replacing only downstream template options is expected not to affect this leaf. Random phases and vector components remain ungraded/API-limited; the human finalized the reported tolerances from the completed calibration evidence.
